category_title: Students who strategically refuse special education services to avoid stigma
scenario_title: Refusing forced assistance during an exam
minimal_context: The student is taking an exam at their desk in the regular classroom while an instructional aide is present.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your exam. Please begin working on it at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'ma just let it go and do it here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You haven't started yet. Let me look at your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even bother anymore. You're just not gonna understand.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, just let me help you. (Reaches to take the test)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs the paperwork and pulls it towards himself) No, I don't need your help - I don't want your help. I'm not - nah - get out of here.

context.environment: Taking tests in the regular classroom instead of the learning center
context.social_setting: Instructional aide present during the exam

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Instructional aide looked at the blank test, said 'You make me sick,' and then tried to grab the test to help
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Laughed, grabbed paper work and put it towards himself, verbally refused help saying 'I don't need your help - I don't want your help' and 'get out of here'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Felt staff are 'just not gonna understand'
